depth_conditional.claim: Depth routing produces per-token depth variation at inference
depth_conditional.evidence: All 16 tokens have identical depth pattern

pathway_conditional.claim: Pathway routing executes only top-k pathways per token at inference
pathway_conditional.evidence: All tokens select exactly 2/3 pathways (mask correct). All 3 pathways called across the batch is expected with diverse routing.
pathway_conditional.detail: Per-token sparsity is PROVEN by mask structure. Per-batch coverage of all pathways is correct behavior, not a sparsity failure.

width_conditional.claim: Width routing assigns different FFN widths to different tokens at inference

expert_conditional.claim: Expert routing dispatches only top-k experts per token at inference
expert_conditional.evidence: All tokens use exactly 2 experts (weight structure verified)
expert_conditional.detail: All 4 experts used across batch — expected with diverse routing and 32 tokens

per_token_distribution.claim: Different tokens execute different amounts of computation

training_depth_no_savings.claim: Training depth routing uses STE (soft mask, block computed for all tokens)
training_depth_no_savings.evidence: Depth mask is binary in training mode
training_depth_no_savings.detail: STE should produce continuous mask values; binary suggests the Gumbel noise path may not be active
